description: This is a JUnit test class for the UserContext component in the OpenMRS project. It tests the behavior of retrieving default location IDs for a user based on user properties set as IDs or UUIDs.

classes.name: UserContextTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify behavior of user context related to default location IDs in OpenMRS.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Sets up a test user and person before each test, creating and saving entities to the database.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Cleans up the test user and person after each test by purging from the database.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldGetDefaultLocationById
methods.description: Verifies that setting a user property as a numeric ID returns the correct location ID.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldGetDefaultLocationByUuid
methods.description: Verifies that setting a user property as a UUID retrieves the corresponding location ID.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldReturnNullForInvalidId
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid numeric ID returns null.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldReturnNullForInvalidUuid
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid UUID returns null.
